newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-General Gold eyes Mt Monger upgrade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-General Gold eyes Mt Monger upgrade.

text.p: General Gold Resources NL said on Tuesday it expects to upgrade the resource at its Mount Monger gold project in Western Australia following the results of drilling at the Maxwells North deposit.
Drilling over a zone 600 metres long, north of the Maxwells pit was nearly concluded, with some high-grade intercepts identified, the company said.
The most promising intercepts included nine metres at 12.68 grams a tonne from 55 metres, 6 metres at 9.49 grams/t from 44 metres and nine metres at 4.30 grams/t from 22 metres, General Gold said.
As of June 30, the mining reserve of Maxwells stood at 1.055 million tonnes, grading 4.1 grams of gold a tonne, containing 138,800 ounces.
A revised resource estimate will be included in the company's September quarterly report, General Gold said.
General Gold has a 50 percent interest in Mount Monger and an 18.1 percent stake in its joint venture partner, Ramsgate Resources NL.
